incidents.title: Crowd at an outdoor concert (drone view)
incidents.story: Risk climbs from LOW to HIGH over 14 s. A surge alert fires at 7.5 s. The rise is partly the drone's view widening to take in more of the crowd, not people arriving.
caveats: Free stock footage (Pexels clip 34004639); the real location is not Hyderabad, the map pin is a demo location.
D_CRIT 40 was tuned for this clip.

incidents.title: 75 people pressing at a 0.5 m entrance (controlled experiment)
incidents.story: A dense crowd is already packed at the gate. A surge alert fires at 3 s as people start pushing and a sustained-high alert at 6 s. Risk falls to LOW as the crowd passes through over 65 s.
caveats: Indoor experiment with volunteers filmed from a fixed overhead camera in Germany, not a drone; the map pin is a demo location.
Shows a crush clearing, not building.
Video is 270 MB and is not included.
